title: Drunk Entitled Lady Crashes Into A House, Resists Arrest & Denies Wrongdoing!
description:
On April 6th, 2023, deputies responded to a report of a white SUV driving with heavy damage. The caller told dispatch the driver appeared impaired. Upon arrival, deputies noticed the white SUV was visibly damaged, with a large piece of lumber noticeably protruding from its front. An initial encounter with the female driver revealed potential signs of impairment, including slurred speech and an odor of alcohol emanating from her person. When asked about the vehicle damage, the suspect stated she crashed a little and had AAA on the phone. Deputies asked the suspect to exit the vehicle, but she refused, stating, "I'm not driving anymore, so there is nothing you can do! I'm not getting out." Deputies repeatedly asked the suspect to exit the vehicle, but she refused, holding onto her steering wheel.

Deputies eventually took the suspect out of the vehicle, placing her under arrest and in handcuffs. As deputies identified the suspect in the patrol vehicle's backseat, the suspect stuck her foot in the door jam, stopping deputies from closing the door, stating, "I will not get in. You can leave the door
open. All I did was crash". She refused deputies’ orders to move her feet, stating, "I'm not some felon. You can't do this," before being placed in the vehicle. The suspect was transported to jail.

The suspect continued to argue her arrest with deputies before being transferred to a nearby hospital for medical clearance due to her hitting a house. The suspect was uninjured and cleared by medical personnel before being returned to jail. The suspect was charged with Resisting Arrest and Obstructing Official Business.
